latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Generator Download.

- Generate and download 1080p MP4 videos from your text or images with a single instruction.
- Supports uploads (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, up to 200MB) and batch processing in one session.
- Instantly create and manage sessions via a backend cloud API—no software install required.
- Export videos for free; no paid software or credit card necessary.
- Designed for content creators and small businesses to create videos quickly and easily.
- Includes error handling for uploads, credits, and session management.
